units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kinnim 2:5">Kinn. II, 5</cite> <he>האשה … חטאתה ת׳ וכ׳</he> if a woman brought a turtle-dove for her sin-offering, and a young pigeon for her burnt-offering; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="V00291"><he>תּוֹרִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00291"><he>תּוֹרִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kinnim 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מביאין ת׳ כנגד וכ׳</he> you must not offer turtle-doves in connection with young pigeons, nor young pigeons in connection with turtle-doves (but either the ones or the others).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:5">Ḥull. I, 5</cite> <he>כשר בת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00203"><he>יוֹנָה</he> II</cite>.
